text.tspan: Why a bastion or a VPN doesn't fix overlapping CIDRs: neither changes the addresses
Pod A wants orders in B
up and running, but no packet
The other end of the tunnel / SSH
Bastion = a door for PEOPLE (SSH or SSM), not a path for app traffic
It sits in one VPC, so it has the same routing problem. Making it carry
app traffic means hand-made SSH tunnels or a proxy: one box, no high
availability, manual, and an extra way in for attackers.
VPN = a pipe between networks; it doesn't change addresses
Routing still picks the local route, so nothing enters the pipe.
It works only with NAT added on both ends: that is option 3,
self-managed on VPN boxes (and about 1.25 Gbps per AWS VPN tunnel).
tunnel or SSH: up, but unused
